newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan kills three, wounds three in one family.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan kills three, wounds three in one family.

text.p: A Moroccan man stabbed to death a father and his two sons and tried to murder three other members of the family in a frenzied attack in the coastal city of Safi, a newspaper said on Friday.

The newspaper, Al-Monaddama, said the three survivors were badly wounded. Police arrested the man, identified as Abdel Hadi al-Arjoune. The paper said he had previous convictions but the motive for the attack earlier this week was unknown.
